forum.content_text:
I created a motion\_fx for stm32h562 from CubeMx. The auto generated motion\_fx.h file does call (line 135)

```

size_t MotionFX_GetStateSize(void);​

```

But the code does miss the include

```

#include <stddef.h>

```

Which results in the following error:

unknown type name 'size\_t' motion\_fx.h ./Middlewares/ST/STM32\_MotionFX\_Library/Inc line 135 C/C++ Problem
